base oils, lubricants and power generation are not on PDF 18 or 66; the direct list is PDF 56 (Downstream activities). Engine items differ in wording from the source: 'retail fuels' (source: retail), 'trading' (supply and trading), 'power' (power generation); 'distribution' is in the source and not in the engine list.

the closest source wording is PDF 8 ('one of the world's largest integrated energy and chemicals companies') and PDF 9 ('Upstream and Downstream, which are supported by Corporate activities'); Codex cites PDF 179/66. 'globally integrated' describes trading (PDF 57), not the company.
